messages:
deploy-bot: Planned maintenance window: rolling deploy of `api-server` v2.12 starting 2024-05-05 22:00 UTC (60m change window). This is a non-disruptive canary -> gradual rollout but will cause short (<5s) connection resets for streaming sessions. Affected: Hosted API (generation + chat). Dedicated and Private deployments: no change unless self-upgraded. Link: https://go.redwood/ops/deploys/1715000000

alexa_pm: tagging for customer comms. Target: update status page and send short email to impacted customers 1h before start. Draft below.

mike_eng_rel: FYI we'll run canary on 3 instances in us-west-2 -> monitor error-rate + p95 latency. If >1% error-rate or p95 regresses >200ms for 5m, abort and rollback to v2.11. Rollback plan: immediate revert + scale up v2.11 pool.

sarah_support: will prepare support canned responses. Can we include which endpoints might show transient 5xxs? so support can triage quickly.
jordan_cs: also prepare outreach for 3 enterprise customers with active long-running sessions (they flagged streaming). We should offer to pin to v2.11 for those customers during the change window.

luis_prod: agree on pinning flow — we should expose a temporary route pin for these three accounts. Ops, can you confirm the pin will be applied before the rollout?

ops-oncall: Confirmed. We'll apply tenant pin for accounts: acme-corp, luminai, and fastreach. Pinning will route them to v2.11 for 6 hours starting 21:50 UTC. We'll also add a feature-flag toggle in case we need to extend.

alexa_pm: Draft comms (short email + status page blurb). Please review/edit: 

"Hello —

We’re performing a scheduled maintenance deployment to the Redwood Hosted API on 2024-05-05 at 22:00 UTC. During the rollout, some streaming sessions may experience short (<5s) connection resets and brief increases in latency. We do not expect data loss.

If you rely on long-lived streaming, we’ve temporarily pinned your account to the previous runtime to avoid interruptions during the window. No action required from you.

If you see unexpected errors after 22:10 UTC, please reply to this email or open a ticket at support@redwood.ai and reference maintenance ID: MNT-1715000000.

— The Redwood Operations Team"

mike_eng_rel: small edit to subject line: "Scheduled maintenance: Hosted API deployment (May 5) — possible short stream resets"

sarah_support: canned Slack reply for support agents: "Thanks — we’re aware of scheduled maintenance (May 5 22:00 UTC). Short stream resets expected. If you’re seeing >5% errors or persistent disconnects, escalate to #eng-oncall and reference MNT-1715000000."

statusbot: Status page updated: page: https://status.redwood.ai/ incidents: "Scheduled maintenance: Hosted API rolling deploy (MNT-1715000000). Expected impact: brief streaming resets, 22:00–23:00 UTC."

luis_prod: Quick checklist before 22:00: canary config pushed, canary alerts configured, rollback tag ready, customer pins set at 21:50, comms scheduled at 21:00. Anything missing?

ops-oncall: Monitoring checklist: synthetic chat flows running, canary traces linked, token-level cost spike alert muted for this window, log retention set to 72h. Also creating a temporary dashboard: /dash/deploy-1715000000

jordan_cs: I pushed the enterprise notes to the CS doc and scheduled the outreach email to the three customers 1h before the window.

alexa_pm: One more: post-deploy follow-up note for customers. Short template: 

"Hello —

The scheduled deployment is complete. We observed brief streaming resets during the canary phase but no customer-impacting incidents. If you continue to see issues, please reply to this message or contact support@redwood.ai.

Thanks,
Redwood Operations"

mike_eng_rel: Deploy started: deploy-bot: canary group pushed to 3 hosts (us-west-2). Observing p95 latency: baseline 280ms -> 310ms (30m rolling average). Error-rate 0.2%. Continuing to gradual rollout.

ops-oncall: watching logs — small increase in 504s for chunked streaming, looks like client reconnects. Alert threshold not hit.

deploy-bot: rollout at 30% capacity (12 hosts) — no automatic abort triggered.

alexa_pm: keeping CS + Support on standby for the next 30m. If we need to extend the pin beyond scheduled 6h for the three customers, we'll loop in account owners.

mike_eng_rel: 22:35 UTC — p95 now back to 290ms, error-rate steady at 0.25%. Closing canary. Proceeding to full rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 22:52 UTC. All hosts on v2.12.

statusbot: Post-update: status page updated to "Completed — no user-impact incidents observed".

jordan_cs: Sent follow-up to enterprises and updated case notes. All three confirmed no issues.

sarah_support: closing support canned thread; will reopen if any tickets come in referencing MNT-1715000000.

ops-oncall: Post-mortem not required, but we'll log the minor reconnects in the deployment notes. I'll attach datapoints to the deploy ticket.

alexa_pm: Thanks everyone. We'll keep the rollout notes and the comms templates in the release folder: go.redwood/release-notes/1715000000. :tada:
